column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- uni_ipl: the programs this package ships and does not grade, one row a program: name<TAB>CLASS<TAB>evidence,
# the CLASS a word lib_excluded.sh accepts and the evidence the builder's measurement (ALL.omit), declared by util_declare_owed.py.

column3: a ProIcon-for-Macintosh program (it opens file windows with wopen): the oracle prints "sorry, hebeng.uni only runs under Macintosh ProIcon" and stops with status 1 whatever input it is given (MEASURED by officer_01 2026-11-17, twice, on unicon 13.3; CEO-1472: a Macintosh stays excluded)

a cursor-addressed terminal game: given a pipe the oracle stops on its stty ioctl ("stty: standard input: Inappropriate ioctl for device", status 4), so there is no terminal session to grade (MEASURED by officer_01 2026-11-17, twice, on unicon 13.3)

it links cfunc (its source names link cfunc) and speaks HTTP to a peer: with no arguments the oracle prints its usage and with a URL it connects out ("cannot connect to localhost:9" measured on unicon 13.3 by officer_01 2026-11-17); Lon moved the loadfunc feature to later and excluded the tests that reach it (CEO-1470)

checks the links of HTML files through the vhttp library, whose link of cfunc loads libcfunc.so through loadfunc: on a local HTML file the oracle prints its answer (MEASURED by officer_01 2026-11-17 on unicon 13.3: From, root, home, bounds, start and counts), and SCRIP stops at the link ("cannot open cfunc.icn"); Lon moved the loadfunc feature to later and excluded the tests that reach it (CEO-1470)
